title: Governed execution design umbrella; proposed 004A durable effect lifecycle
objective: Define and later prove a bounded Ananke-authoritative governed-effect lifecycle with durable pre-dispatch evidence, explicit dispatch/outcome/indeterminate states, idempotent duplicate handling, crash/restart recovery, and bounded reconciliation, without making an OS-containment or host-wide bypass claim.

repositoriesInvolved.name: ananke
repositoriesInvolved.role: Primary 004A owner for authority binding, durable effect lifecycle, dispatch marker, adapter custody, outcome, duplicate handling, and reconciliation.

repositoriesInvolved.name: horae
repositoriesInvolved.role: Bounded canonical route, freshness/admission, relay, timeout and result projection; no authority or reconciliation.

repositoriesInvolved.name: fates-integration
repositoriesInvolved.role: Design gate, requirements, compatibility/checkpoint control, cross-Fate validation, evidence and eventual seal.

repositoriesInvolved.name: runtime-contracts
repositoriesInvolved.role: No change in 004A unless a separately approved neutral structural contract need is proven.

repositoriesInvolved.name: moirae-code
repositoriesInvolved.role: No 004A implementation; canonical 004C host-mediated effects are deferred until canonical 004B containment is accepted and closed.

repositoriesInvolved.name: mnemosyne
repositoriesInvolved.role: No 004A implementation; memory/provenance remains outside the effect authority path.

contractChanges: None authorized in this design checkpoint.
Any Runtime Contracts change requires a separate neutral-contract design gate and compatibility checkpoint.
repositoryOrder: Owner selects one bounded non-hostile effect and its authoritative/reconciliation semantics
Ananke implements and validates durable authority/effect lifecycle
Horae validates canonical route, freshness, timeout, and result projection
Integration validates cross-Fate behavior and secret-free evidence
Owner separately authorizes any live acceptance and later seal
requiredConsumerTests: Ananke: approval binding, durable pre-dispatch intent, dispatch marker, authoritative success/failure, indeterminate state, duplicate handling, crash/restart recovery, bounded reconciliation, and secret-free audit.
Horae: fresh admission, canonical relay, bounded timeout/cancellation, late-result handling, and no authority/fallback/retry behavior.
Runtime Contracts: unchanged baseline validation; no structural field is treated as authority, persistence, or outcome truth.
Moirae and Mnemosyne: unchanged and outside 004A implementation; host containment and memory provenance require separate gates.
integrationTests: One bounded route proves durable intent before dispatch and exactly one dispatch marker.
The six lifecycle distinctions are represented in portable, secret-free evidence.
Duplicate/replay and restart do not create a second effect call.
Pre-dispatch timeout is distinct from post-dispatch indeterminate timeout; reconciliation is separately evidenced.
No route, memory, host, or structural-contract participant widens Ananke authority.
No live acceptance is performed without a separate owner authorization.
deferredWork: FATES-SLICE-004B strict host containment (remapped from conceptual 003B).
FATES-SLICE-004C host-mediated developer effects (remapped from conceptual 004B) after canonical 004B and 004A.
Generic arbitrary effects, automatic retry/fallback, provider failover, and exactly-once claims.
Any shared Runtime Contracts lifecycle/idempotency extension.
stopConditions: Stop if implementation needs host containment, a Moirae source change, Mnemosyne authority, or a Runtime Contracts change not separately gated.
Stop if an effect cannot distinguish never-dispatched from possibly-dispatched or cannot be safely reconciled.
Stop if duplicate/restart can cause more than one effect call for one idempotency binding.
Stop on credential exposure, direct/fallback dispatch, unbounded retry, or evidence ambiguity.
Do not change active-slice.json, fates-lock.json, compatibility-matrix.json, the R1 snapshot/evidence, or historical tags during this design checkpoint.
